channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Funeral for family killed in US strike on Iran’s Qeshm Island
item.description: The funeral for a couple and their toddler took place after they were killed in the US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island.

item.title: US says deal on reopening Hormuz close as Iran, Oman hold ‘positive’ talks
item.description: Negotiators are working to expand safe shipping through the strait, though key differences remain unresolved.

item.title: ‘I wanted to hug whatever remained’: Gaza families’ 3-year wait for funeral
item.description: Thousands gather for mass funeral of 112 members of Abu Shreia and al-Hassaina families killed in 2023 Israeli attack.

item.title: Argentina grain exports halt as maritime pilots strike over Milei decree
item.description: More than 45 vessels have been affected by the strike at Argentinian ports.

item.title: ‘Maximum use’: Iran boosts military strength during ceasefire with US
item.description: IRGC spokesman Hossein Mohebbi said last month that Iran's missile production rate increased during the ceasefire.

item.title: Rubio: Progress made to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Marco Rubio, US Secretary of State, said there has been progress in negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Mass funeral in Gaza for 112 Palestinians killed in 2023 Israeli strike
item.description: The bodies - belonging to members of two extended families - have only recently been recovered from under rubble in Gaza City.

item.title: How a generation of record-setting guides died in a disaster that killed a climbing legend
item.description: Their fellow guides say their deaths in Pakistan dealt a devastating blow to Nepal's mountaineering community.
